summary.zh: 用 Tokio 编写并发安全的异步 Rust 代码
summary.en: Write concurrent async Rust with Tokio

description.zh: 覆盖 Tokio 运行时、异步 trait、错误传播与常见并发模式，帮助搭建或调试异步 Rust 服务。适合实现高并发任务、worker pool 或排查 async 代码卡住的问题。
description.en: Covers the Tokio runtime, async traits, error propagation, and concurrency patterns for building or debugging async Rust services, including hangs and high-throughput workloads.
